name: atebites-plugins
description: atebites-hub plugin catalog for ZCode: open-dynamic-workflows, ponytail, Advisor, taskboard, and j-space. Local path sources only.

plugins.name: open-dynamic-workflows
plugins.description: Dynamic workflow orchestration for ZCode — fan a deterministic script out across many zcode subagents.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Forces the laziest solution that works. YAGNI, stdlib first, one line over fifty.

plugins.name: sol-advisor
plugins.description: Advisor routing with strict ZCode runtime attestation.

plugins.name: taskboard
plugins.description: Per-repo Taskboard coordination: sprint tickets, local SQLite board, and the taskboard-workflow skill.

plugins.name: j-space
plugins.description: Inference-time workspace control for long-horizon work: selective loading, ledger at seams, named verification, and recovery.
